verdicts.reason: Both are badly broken in similar ways. The logo is blown up to a giant, overpowering circle. A leftover fragment of the dark header bar is stranded in the top-right corner, and the orange divider floats far from the text it belongs to. The 'Reserve a Case' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill that is buried under the body copy, and 'Ships late June' and the legal line are too small to read. B is slightly worse because its oversized logo collides with the stranded dark bar at top-right and crowds the canvas edge, while A's logo sits cleanly on the left as a lead-in to the headline. A still has the orphaned bar and divider on the right.
